# Human Real-Video Edit Records

This is a cumulative document. Records are produced serially in batches of 20 source videos, with three independent edit edges per video.

`instruction` contains only temporal placement, the explicit target, and one edit operation. Preservation requirements and protected text layers appear only in structured fields.

`E2B` is semantically independent of `E1` but must remain compatible with it: the two visual results are required to coexist in C.

The 45 Style records use the nearest-even allocation across the six Style subtypes defined in `Key Concept.md`: three global subtypes have 8 records each and three local subtypes have 7 records each.

- Current range: `human_001`-`human_200`
- Source videos: 200
- Edit records: 600
- Branches: `E1: A_to_B`, `E2A: A_to_D`, `E2B: B_to_C`
